section.content: 本发明提供了一种PEO基薄膜包覆硅碳电极的制备方法与应用。该方法包括以下步骤：1)制备硅碳负极电极片作为基底；2)配制PEO基混合溶液，将配制好的溶液刮涂在硅碳电极基底上；3)晾干硅碳电极片，得到PEO基薄膜包覆的硅碳电极，将其应用在锂离子电池中。本发明利用PEO的弹性以及锂盐可传导锂离子的性质，配制PEO与锂盐的混合溶液。将混合溶液刮涂在硅碳电极片，使其形成一层保护薄膜。当PEO基混合溶液的PEO质量浓度为3％时，其电池表现出最优的循环稳定性。在充放电过程中，薄膜中的锂盐可传导锂离子，弹性PEO膜可缓冲在充放电过程中体积膨胀所带来的应力，减小电极片的破裂粉碎。

The invention provides a preparation method and application of a PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode. The method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing a silicon-carbon negative electrode plate as a substrate; 2) preparing a PEO-based mixed solution, and blade-coating the prepared solution on a silicon-carbon electrode substrate; 3) and (4) airing the silicon-carbon electrode plate to obtain the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode, and applying the silicon-carbon electrode in the lithium ion battery. The invention utilizes the elasticity of PEO and the property that lithium salt can conduct lithium ions to prepare the mixed solution of PEO and lithium salt. And (3) blade-coating the mixed solution on a silicon-carbon electrode plate to form a layer of protective film. When the PEO mass concentration of the PEO-based mixed solution was 3%, the battery exhibited the optimum cycle stability. During the charging and discharging processes, lithium salt in the film can conduct lithium ions, and the elastic PEO film can buffer stress caused by volume expansion during the charging and discharging processes, so that breakage and crushing of the electrode plate are reduced.

Preparation and application of PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrodeTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to preparation and application of a PEO-based film-coated silicon-carbon electrode.

Background

Aiming at the problems of global warming and energy crisis faced at present, the search for renewable energy and high-performance energy storage equipment is of great importance. Rechargeable Lithium Ion Batteries (LIBs) have received much attention in energy storage devices due to their advantages of long life, high energy and power density, chemical stability, and absence of potential environmental pollutants. In addition, LIBs have been widely used as power sources for portable electronic devices and hybrid cars.

Theoretical capacity of commercial graphite electrode (372mAh g) considering limitation of energy capacity-1) Silicon (Si) has not been able to meet the current energy requirements as the negative electrode material of the next generation of high energy LIB due to its ultra high theoretical intercalation capacity (4200mAh g)-1) But is of great interest. In addition, silicon has a high elemental abundance (the second highest content in the crust), thus ensuring its sustainability of energy storage. However, the volume change of the silicon material during lithium deintercalation in LIB limits its practical application. The nearly 300% volume expansion during the charge and discharge of silicon causes a series of problems including pulverization of silicon particles, peeling of active materials from electrodes, and continuous formation of Solid Electrolyte (SEI). During repeated discharge-charge, the Si particles on the anode will electrochemically "die", resulting in a rapid degradation of the anode performance.

Many solutions to the problems of silicon anodes are currently proposed, and various types of Si nanotopography have been designed to improve the electrochemical performance of Si anodes, including Nanowires (NWs), films, porous structures and nanocomposites. However, without proper surface protection, the bare Si Nanoparticles (NPs) can still be pulverized by lithium deintercalation lithiation. Therefore, there is a need to continue to enhance the investigation of silicon anodes.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention provides a preparation method of a PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode, which mainly utilizes the elasticity of PEO and the property that lithium salt can conduct lithium ions. The thin film formed on the surface of the electrode does not inhibit the conduction of lithium ions due to the presence of the lithium salt. When the volume changes during charging and discharging, the elastic PEO film on the surface of the electrode plate can relieve the stress generated by the change, reduce the falling of crushed particles caused by electrode fracture, and ensure that the active substance and the current collector keep relatively good electric contact, thereby obtaining better long-cycle stability.

It is yet another object of the present invention to provide the use of a PEO-based thin film coated silicon carbon electrode.

The above object of the present invention is achieved by the following technical solutions:

(1) weighing silicon-carbon negative electrode materials, a water-based binder and a conductive agent (super P), uniformly mixing and grinding according to a certain proportion, adding a proper amount of ultrapure water, and placing on a magnetic stirrer to fully stir for 8 hours. Coating, and drying at 80 deg.C in a vacuum drying oven.

(2) Dissolving PEO in acetonitrile solvent, fully stirring for dissolving, and adding lithium salt to obtain PEO-based mixed solution.

(3) And fixing the dried silicon-carbon electrode plate on a glass plate, selecting a proper scraper thickness, coating a PEO mixed solution on the electrode plate, airing in a glove box, and volatilizing an acetonitrile solvent to obtain the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode.

The silicon-carbon negative electrode material in the step (1) includes, but is not limited to, silicon carbon 650 and silicon carbon 480.

The proportion of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material, the aqueous binder and the conductive agent (super P) in the step (1) includes, but is not limited to, 8:1:1, 6:2: 2.

The lithium salt in the step (2) comprises one or more of lithium hexafluorophosphate, lithium perchlorate, lithium bistrifluoromethanesulfonylimide and lithium bistrifluoromethanesulfonylimide.

The mass fraction of PEO in the PEO-based mixed solution in the step (2) is 1-5%, preferably 1-3%.

The molar ratio of the PEO to the lithium salt in the PEO-based mixed solution in the step (3) is 1: 5-1: 25, and preferably 1: 10-1: 20.

The thickness of the scraper in the step (3) is 250 mm-750 mm, specifically 500 mm.

The silicon-carbon electrode coated by the PEO-based film is applied to the preparation of a high-energy lithium ion battery and has good cycle performance.

A PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode lithium ion battery is composed of a positive plate, a diaphragm, electrolyte and a negative plate. The positive plate is made of a silicon-carbon negative electrode material; the diaphragm is made of polyethylene film; the electrolyte is carbonate solvent Ethylene Carbonate (EC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC) and molecular sieve to remove water, and the mass ratio of the electrolyte is 1: 1:1 mixing, 5% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) was added; the negative plate adopts a lithium plate. The lithium ion battery is a CR2025 button battery.

In the charging and discharging processes of the prepared silicon-carbon electrode coated by the PEO-based film, the elastic PEO film on the surface of the electrode plate can relieve stress generated by the change, and the falling of crushed particles caused by electrode breakage is reduced, so that the active substance and the current collector are kept in relatively good electric contact, and meanwhile, lithium salt in the film formed on the surface of the electrode can conduct lithium ions, and the open circuit of the battery cannot be caused.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages and effects:

the prepared PEO-based film-coated silicon-carbon electrode mainly utilizes the elasticity of PEO and the property that lithium salt can conduct lithium ions. The thin film formed on the surface of the electrode does not inhibit the conduction of lithium ions due to the presence of the lithium salt. When the volume changes during charging and discharging, the elastic PEO film on the surface of the electrode plate can relieve the stress generated by the change, reduce the falling of crushed particles caused by electrode fracture, and ensure that the active substance and the current collector keep relatively good electric contact, thereby obtaining better long-cycle stability.

Detailed Description

The present invention will be described in detail with reference to specific examples below:

example 1

(1) Weighing silicon carbon 650 as a silicon carbon negative electrode material, a water-based binder, namely sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC), Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR) and a conductive agent (superP), and mixing the materials in a mass ratio of 8: 0.5: 0.5; 1, uniformly mixing and grinding, adding a proper amount of ultrapure water, and placing on a magnetic stirrer to fully stir for 8 hours. Coating, and drying at 80 deg.C in a vacuum drying oven.

(2) Dissolving PEO in acetonitrile solution, fully mixing and dissolving, adding lithium bis (trifluoromethanesulfonyl) imide, and preparing a mixed solution with the PEO mass fraction of 1%, wherein the molar ratio of PEO to lithium salt is 1: 15.

(3) And fixing the dried silicon-carbon electrode plate on a glass plate, selecting a 500mm scraper, coating the PEO mixed solution on the electrode plate, drying in a glove box, and volatilizing the acetonitrile solvent to obtain the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode.

Comparison of effects

Electrochemical test comparative analysis is carried out on the poly-dopamine modified silicon-carbon electrode plate prepared in the embodiment 2 and a common silicon-carbon electrode plate assembled battery.

Fig. 1 is a graph of specific discharge capacity after 100 cycles of the lithium ion batteries prepared in inventive example 2 and comparative example of the present invention. Example 1 and comparative example used button CR2025 type cells that were charged and discharged at constant current at 0.01-2V using the novice cell test system. The analysis of the graph shows that the cycle performance of the battery installed on the electrode plate of the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode is improved compared with that of the battery of the comparative example.
